title: Understanding resilience capacities in rural agro-industries: evidence from Spanish wineries
core_idea: Analyze the resilience capacities—robustness, adaptability, and transformability—of 411 Spanish wineries by assessing how internal attributes (size, structure, innovation, rural commitment) interact with perceived economic, environmental, and social challenges to shape strategic responses, using survey data and ordinary least squares modeling.
tldr: The study examines how internal characteristics and external challenges influence Spanish wineries' resilience across three dimensions (robustness, adaptability, transformability), based on a survey of 411 firms and OLS analysis, with the goal of informing strategies and policy for rural agro-industries.
